lesson-environment-management-environmen.quote: A covered project must follow its clearance conditions and other laws.
lesson-environment-management-environmen.note: The merged treatment includes Traps to Watch For and also retains an optional shortcut section.

lesson-environment-management-environmen.quote: The facts show sorting but no diversion. All the waste still went to disposal.
lesson-environment-management-environmen.note: Example 9 tests diversion versus sorting; Example 15 adds a disaster-phase application.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: The law also made wider changes to disaster-risk management.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: The lesson now has a full Traps to Watch For section after examples and shortcuts.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: The documents serve different duties. An ECC does not replace the required discharge permit.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: All listed laws now have cases, followed by harder coverage and overlapping-permit scenarios.

lesson-environment-management-environmen.quote: Coverage depends on official project and location rules.
lesson-environment-management-environmen.note: The dense ECP/ECA sentence is replaced by short paragraphs and separate explained categories.

lesson-environment-management-environmen.quote: A **project proponent** is the person, company, or agency that wants to carry out a project.
lesson-environment-management-environmen.note: Defines proponent before the ECC teaching and worked project cases.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: The law renamed the existing National Disaster Coordinating Council as the **National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC)**.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: Corrects creation-from-nothing wording to renaming the existing council.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: Republic Act (RA) $9003$ is the **Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of $2000$**.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: Statute numbers, section identifiers, and years are wrapped in inline math throughout.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: The law states exceptions to this particular ban.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: The incineration rule is split into short statements with exceptions described separately.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: 1. The actions involve source segregation and waste diversion.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: The waste solution begins directly with numbered reasoning; no unnumbered lead-in remains.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: RA $10121$, the Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of $2010$, made that change.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: The disaster-law answer is now a permitted single-step sentence, without a separate lead-in.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: EMB is part of DENR, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: The parent-department answer is now a single-step sentence with no extra reasoning instruction.
Defines segregation and diversion locally and explains their operational difference.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: The framework guides planning, research, public information, and checks on climate action.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: Explains framework purpose and distinguishes original wording from the amended name.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: It also lists traditional burning for farming, culture, health, and food preparation, plus crematoria, where human remains are cremated.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: Names the exceptions and explains that other environmental laws still apply.

lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.quote: Section $11$ of the original RA $9729$ required a **Framework Strategy on Climate Change**.
lesson-environment-management-the-enviro.note: Correctly identifies the original name and then describes the later statutory amendment.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: An **Environmentally Critical Project (ECP)** is identified by project type and scale.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Adds listed project types, scale qualifications, and a major-dam coverage case.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: An **Environmentally Critical Area (ECA)** is identified by a location's special features or risks.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Adds location categories, conditional water-body coverage, and a sanctuary screening case.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: It requires environmental review of covered projects before they begin.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Explains how PD 1586 operates through coverage checks, review, and ECC conditions.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: Diversion reduces the waste that goes to final disposal.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Supplies local operational definitions and a sorting-without-diversion example.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: This was a temporary rule, not continuing permission for all medical-waste burning.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Teaches toxic-fume conditions, named exceptions, the transition rule, and treatment compliance.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: The board coordinates policies and checks progress on the area's action plan.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Explains area designation using shared water boundaries and management by a coordinating board.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: It states the allowed amount and quality of discharge, the schedule for meeting requirements, and monitoring duties.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Explains permits, applicable pollutant limits, testing, reporting, and compliance conditions.

general-information-environment-manageme.quote: Regional offices carry out laws and programs in their regions.
general-information-environment-manageme.note: Adds enforcement and standards duties, regional implementation, and conditional water-administration transfer.
